title: Tanya and Toys
statementMd:
In Berland recently a new collection of toys went on sale. This collection consists of $10^{9}$ types of toys, numbered with integers from $1$ to $10^{9}$. A toy from the new collection of the $*i*$-th type costs $*i*$ bourles.

Tania has managed to collect $*n*$ different types of toys $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ from the new collection. Today is Tanya's birthday, and her mother decided to spend no more than $*m*$ bourles on the gift to the daughter. Tanya will choose several different types of toys from the new collection as a gift. Of course, she does not want to get a type of toy which she already has.

Tanya wants to have as many distinct types of toys in her collection as possible as the result. The new collection is too diverse, and Tanya is too little, so she asks you to help her in this.

## Input

The first line contains two integers $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$) and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$) — the number of types of toys that Tanya already has and the number of bourles that her mom is willing to spend on buying new toys.

The next line contains $*n*$ distinct integers $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the types of toys that Tanya already has.

## Output

In the first line print a single integer $*k*$ — the number of different types of toys that Tanya should choose so that the number of different types of toys in her collection is maximum possible. Of course, the total cost of the selected toys should not exceed $*m*$.

In the second line print $*k*$ distinct space-separated integers $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*k*}$ ($1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the types of toys that Tanya should choose.

If there are multiple answers, you may print any of them. Values of $*t*_{*i*}$ can be printed in any order.

## Note

In the first sample mom should buy two toys: one toy of the $2$-nd type and one toy of the $5$-th type. At any other purchase for $7$ bourles (assuming that the toys of types $1$, $3$ and $4$ have already been bought), it is impossible to buy two and more toys.
statementZhMd:
最近，Berland 上架了一套新的玩具收藏。这套收藏包含 $10^{9}$ 种玩具，编号为从 $1$ 到 $10^{9}$ 的整数。新收藏中第 $*i*$ 种玩具的价格为 $*i*$ 卢布。

Tanya 已经收集了新收藏中的 $*n*$ 种不同类型的玩具 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$。今天是 Tanya 的生日，她的母亲决定最多花费 $*m*$ 卢布为女儿购买礼物。Tanya 将从新收藏中选择若干种不同类型的玩具作为礼物。当然，她不想得到自己已经拥有的玩具类型。

Tanya 希望最终自己的收藏中拥有尽可能多的不同类型的玩具。新收藏种类繁多，而 Tanya 年纪还小，因此她请求你帮助她完成这件事。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$）和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *m* ≤ 10^{9}$）——Tanya 已经拥有的玩具类型数量，以及她的母亲愿意购买新玩具所花费的卢布数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个互不相同的整数 $*a*_{1}, *a*_{2}, ..., *a*_{*n*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——Tanya 已经拥有的玩具类型。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数 $*k*$——Tanya 应该选择的不同玩具类型数量，使得她的收藏中不同玩具类型的数量尽可能多。当然，所选玩具的总价格不能超过 $*m*$。

第二行输出 $*k*$ 个以空格分隔且互不相同的整数 $*t*_{1}, *t*_{2}, ..., *t*_{*k*}$（$1 ≤ *t*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——Tanya 应该选择的玩具类型。

如果有多个答案，可以输出任意一个。$*t*_{*i*}$ 的顺序任意。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，妈妈应该购买两个玩具：一个第 $2$ 种玩具和一个第 $5$ 种玩具。对于花费 $7$ 卢布的其他任何购买方案（假设第 $1$、$3$ 和 $4$ 种玩具已经被购买），都不可能购买两个或更多玩具。
